system.description:
Favoured weapon: Hammer, War

Granted power: Advantage on Perception checks underground or in stone structures.

  • While you stand on natural stone or earth, you can't be pushed or knocked Prone against your will.
  • Once/day, when your Smite hits, the stone heaves: the target makes a Fortitude save or is knocked Prone.

Allegiance: Lawful Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Moradin in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: defend one hold or clan as your own (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
